to content\nSEARCH\nMENU\nHOW DO I\nHOME\nDEPARTMENTS & SERVICES\nAdministration\n\nThe Administration Department of the Clerk’s Office is charged by the Clerk with a number of responsibilities. Included among these are:\n\nClerk to the Board of County Commissioners, responsible for attending all meetings of the Board and recording and preserving the minutes of all proceedings; maintaining the Board’s records, including ordinances, agreements and contracts, and resolutions; and the Value Adjustment Board.\n\nFixed Asset Control\n\nHuman Resources\n\nPurchasing and Inventory Control\n\nRecords Management\n\nSpecial Projects\n\nTax Deed Sales\n\nOffice Systems Including Telephone Systems, Copiers, and Fax Machines\n\nDepartments of the Clerk’s Office\nCriminal Department\n\nThe Criminal Department for the Clerk of the Court oversees Jury Management, Traffic, Misdemeanor, and Circuit Felony.\n\nCivil Department\n\nThe Civil Department for the Clerk of the Court oversees Juvenile, County Civil Courts, Family Law, Guardianship, Circuit Probate, Circuit Civil Division\n\nFinance Department\n\nThe Finance Department of the Clerk’s Office works closely with the Board of County Commissioners and all departments under the Board and the Clerk.\n\nRecording\n\nThe Clerk of the Circuit Court is charged by the Constitution and Laws of the State of Florida as the Recorder of all instruments that may be required or authorized by law to be recorded in Levy County. These duties and responsibilities are handled by the Recording Department.\n\nIn addition to recording, indexing, and maintaining the Official Records, the Recording Department also issues marriage licenses.\n\nLeadership Team\nMatt Brooks\nMatt Brooks\n\nCLERK OF THE CIRCUIT COURT & COMPTROLLER\n\n(352) 486-5266\nREAD MORE\nBrooke Willis\nBrooke Willis\n\nCHIEF OF OPERATIONS, FINANCE ASSISTANT TO THE CLERK\n\n352-486-5266 X-1227\nFaith Southard\nFaith Southard\n\nADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES SUPERVISOR\n\n(352) 486-5266 EXT. 1223\nJohnna Agin\nJohnna Agin\n\nDIRECTOR OF FINANCE\n\n352-486-5266 X-1268\nC Cowart Crt Services Dir\nChris Cowart\n\nDIRECTOR OF COURT SERVICES\n\n352-486-5266 X-1226\nDenise Fowler\nDenise Fowler\n\nSENIOR DEPUTY CLERK - CRIMINAL\n\n(352) 486-5266 EXT. 1246\nMichelle Thompson\nMichelle Thompson\n\nSENIOR DEPUTY CLERK - CIVIL\n\n352-486-5266 X-1258\nEXPLORE THIS SECTION\nCourt Services\nRecords Management\nOnline Services\nFinance Department\nAdministration\nEmployment Opportunities\nTax Deed Sales\nValue Adjustment Board\n\nAddress\n\n355 South Court Street\nBronson, FL 32621\n\nCourthouse Hours\n\nMonday - Friday\n8 AM to 5 PM\nfollow us on facebook link opens in a new tab\nfollow us on youtube link opens in a new tab\nMAKE A PAYMENT\n\n©2026 Levy County, Clerk of the Circuit Court and Comptroller. to content\nSEARCH\nMENU\nHOW DO I\nHOME\nRECORDS MANAGEMENT\nPublic Records\nDisclaimer\n\nThe Levy County Clerk of Court (hereinafter referred to as “Clerk”) is pleased to offer Internet access to certain public records of Levy County. Users should be aware of and accept the terms of the following disclaimer.\n\nThe Clerk will endeavor to ensure the accuracy of the web version of the Official Records Index and the Board Minutes of Levy County. However, these records are not the official records. Only the Official Records Index and the Board of County Commissioners Minutes in the County Courthouse are to be considered the official records of the county, and should there be any difference between the web version and the one that resides at the courthouse, the Official Records Index and Board Minutes in the courthouse will take precedence.\n\nThe Clerk disclaims any responsibility of, and will make no representation or warranty as to the quality, accuracy, content or completeness of any information contained on the web site version of the Official Records Index or Board Minutes. Assessing accuracy and reliability of information is the responsibility of the user.\n\nThe Clerk will not be liable for damages of any nature whatsoever resulting from the use or misuse of the web version of the Official Records Index or Board Minutes, and/or the information contained in it. The user agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Clerk and anyone involved in storing, retrieving, or displaying this information for any damage of any type that may be caused by retrieving this information over the internet.\n\nBy accepting this disclaimer, you will be able to view Levy County Official records that have been Recorded since 1983 till present.\n\nCONTINUE TO OFFICIAL RECORD SEARCH\nPublic Records Requests\n\nIf you are unable to locate a desired record online or would like to make a request for records held in the custody of the Levy County Clerk of Court, send a request by mail or by email. The cost of providing copies of court and official records is $1 per page. For administrative records, the cost is $.15 per page. Some requests may require an additional fee for research or programming.\n\nSend an Email Request\n\nlevypublic@levyclerk.com\n\nUnder Florida law, e-mail addresses are public records. If you do not want your email address released in response to a public-records request, do not send electronic mail to this entity. Instead, contact this office by phone or in writing.\n\nSend a Request by Mail\n\nLevy County Clerk of Court\nPublic Records Custodian\n355 South Court Street\nBronson, FL 32621-6520\n\nEXPLORE THIS SECTION\nCourt Services\nRecords Management\nBoard Minutes / Audio / Video\nElectronic Court & Records Access\nMarriage Licenses\nOfficial Records\nNotices\nPublic Records\nOnline Services\nFinance Department\nAdministration\n\nAddress\n\n355 South Court Street\nBronson, FL 32621\n\nCourthouse Hours\n\nMonday - Friday\n8 AM to 5 PM\nfollow us on facebook link opens in a new tab\nfollow us on youtube link opens in a new tab\nMAKE A PAYMENT\n\n©2026 Levy County, Clerk of the Circuit Court and Comptroller. to content\nSEARCH\nMENU\nHOW DO I\nHOME\nDEPARTMENTS & SERVICES\nCourt Services\nRole of the Clerk’s Office\n\nThe Clerk’s Office is responsible for the following services and duties within the court system:\n\nAttend each session of Court\n\nFile indictments, information, and verdicts\n\nProcess all Civil and Criminal cases\n\nPrepare Appellate records\n\nOversee Jury Management\n\nFile, secure, and dispose of all evidence entered by the Court\n\nAssist victims of abuse in completing paperwork necessary to file Domestic and Repeat Violence actions\n\nAssist in completing paperwork necessary to file for a Simplified Divorce\n\nAssist in completing paperwork necessary to file a Small Claims action\n\nAssist in completing paperwork required to file a Landlord/Tenant action\n\nReceive and disburse moneys for fines, court costs, forfeitures, fees, service charges, alimony and child support, victim restitution, and certain monies to be held in trusts\n\nInformation Regarding Requests for Redactions\n\nAny person preparing or filing a court document should not include a social security number or a complete bank account, debit, charge, or credit card number in such document, unless required by law or court rule, or necessary to the adjudication of the case.\n\nAny person has a right to request that the Clerk of the Circuit Court remove from an image or copy of a court document a social security number or complete bank account, debit, charge, or credit card number contained in a court document. Such request must be made in writing and delivered by mail, or in person to the Clerk of the Circuit Court. The request must specify the case number, the title of the document, and the identification page number of the document that contains the number to be redacted.\n\nA fee will not be charged for the redaction of a social security number or a complete bank account, debit, charge, or credit card number pursuant to such a request.\n\nFrequently Asked Questions\nWhen do I deposit money into the Registry of Court?\n\nWhen the Court where the suit was filed issues a court order, then monies can be accepted into the Registry of Court.\n\nAre personal checks accepted and how should the check be made out?\n\nOnly checks from law firms and certain other government agencies are accepted, otherwise cash or cashier’s check will be required. The check should be made out to “Levy County Clerk of Circuit Court”.\n\nWhere can I pay the money owed?\n\nPayments can be made at the court department where the case was filed. You will need to know the case number and/or names on the case. If you have a copy of the court order, please bring it with you.\n\nIs there a fee to make deposits into the Registry of Court?\n\nThe fee for depositing into the Registry of Court is 3% of the first $500.00 and 1.5% of the balance.\n\nHow do I find out if money has been deposited into the Registry of Court?\n\nPlease contact the Court Department where the case was filed.\n\nIf I am entitled to monies in the Registry of Court, when can I receive the money?\n\nApproximately thirty (30) working days after the court order directing the funds to be released.\n\nEXPLORE THIS SECTION\nCourt Services\nCircuit (Felony) Criminal Cases\nDomestic Violence\nEvictions\nFamily Law\nForeclosure Sales\nJury Duty\nOnline Forms\nProbate\nSmall Claims\nTraffic Department\nRecords Management\nOnline Services\nFinance Department\nAdministration\n\nAddress\n\n355 South Court Street\nBronson, FL 32621\n\nCourthouse Hours\n\nMonday - Friday\n8 AM to 5 PM\nfollow us on facebook link opens in a new tab\nfollow us on youtube link opens in a new tab\nMAKE A PAYMENT\n\n©2026 Levy County, Clerk of the Circuit Court and Comptroller.
